title: reconcile_multiset_rows input
$comment: Raw transport constraints: one UTF-8 JSON object; input at most262144bytes, output at most524288bytes including newline. Duplicate object keys, nonfinite numbers, unpaired Unicode surrogates, decoded depth>8 or more than50000 decoded values refuse. JSON numeric tokens are at most128characters and must represent exact integers within+-1000000000000; integral decimal/exponent spellings are accepted. Structural schemas do not encode byte ceilings or stated cross-field conditions.
description: Multiset equality uses exact flat row fields, numeric integer equality and distinct Boolean/null/string types; missing differs from null. Output arrays sort by compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON serialization, not numeric column order.
